allow: Bash(curl -sL --max-time 20 https://churroslinux.org -o /tmp/churros.html; echo "size: $\(wc -c < /tmp/churros.html\)"; grep -oE 'href="[^"]*\\.css[^"]*"|rel="stylesheet"' /tmp/churros.html | head; grep -oE 'font-family:[^;}]*' /tmp/churros.html | head)

Bash(python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
html = open\('/tmp/churros.html'\).read\(\)
# strip scripts/styles
html = re.sub\(r'<\(script|style\)[^>]*>.*?</\\1>', '', html, flags=re.S\)
# print tag skeleton with classes for structure
for m in re.finditer\(r'<\(body|h1|h2|h3|nav|header|footer|section|a|button|img|p\)\\b\([^>]*\)>', html\):
    attrs = m.group\(2\)
    cls = re.search\(r'class="\([^"]*\)"', attrs\)
    src = re.search\(r'src="\([^"]*\)"', attrs\)
    href = re.search\(r'href="\([^"]*\)"', attrs\)
    print\(m.group\(1\), '|', \(cls.group\(1\) if cls else ''\)[:90], '|', \(href or src\).group\(1\) if \(href or src\) else ''\)
EOF)
